==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I have created a miniature town. The buildings are made of cardboard and decorated with colorful lights. I am presenting my creation at a convention.

My presentation is interrupted by an angry woman. The woman is mad that one of my friends, a super powered martial artist, fought her husband. I stop my presentation to go investigate.

Somehow I find myself underwater, as I continue searching for my friend. I am surrounded by tall coral pillars and I seemingly can breathe underwater. I am starting to believe that my friend and I likely aren't human.
